task.prompt:
Implement a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure that performs the data changes shown in the attached set of worked examples.The procedure operates only on the tables whose starting states are shown in those examples.

The exact procedure signature is:
sp(para_height integer, para_birthday text, para_player_api_id integer, para_id integer, para_team_short_name text, para_team_fifa_api_id integer)

Return the complete stored procedure source and nothing else.

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(
  para_height integer,
  para_birthday text,
  para_player_api_id integer,
  para_id integer,
  para_team_short_name text,
  para_team_fifa_api_id integer
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_phase integer := 9;
BEGIN
  -- ===================== Player =====================
  -- Remove players whose player_api_id is below the threshold
  DELETE FROM "Player"
   WHERE player_api_id < para_player_api_id;

  -- Set the birthday phase marker for every remaining player
  UPDATE "Player"
     SET birthday = para_birthday || '_phase_' || v_phase;

  -- Height adjustments (only when a positive target height is given)
  IF para_height > 0 THEN
    IF para_id < 0 THEN
      UPDATE "Player"
         SET height = para_height - v_phase
       WHERE height <= para_height;
    ELSE
      UPDATE "Player"
         SET height = para_height + 2 - ((height + para_id) % 2)
       WHERE height <= para_height;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ===================== Team =====================
  -- Remove teams whose fifa id is not above the threshold (NULLs are kept)
  DELETE FROM "Team"
   WHERE team_fifa_api_id <= para_team_fifa_api_id;

  -- Mark the remaining teams
  UPDATE "Team"
     SET team_short_name = 'log_phase_' || v_phase;
END;
$$;
